description: This file defines the 'Column' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling table columns in worksheet spreadsheets. It includes properties and methods to manage column attributes such as index, filter button visibility, total row labels, formulas, and references to the parent table. The class also provides methods for updating structured references in formulas and named formulas within worksheets.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a table column within a worksheet, encapsulating properties such as column index, filter button visibility, total row labels, formulas, and a reference to its parent table. Provides mechanisms to update structured references within formulas when table headers change.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Column with a specified column label and optional parent table.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the column index as a string (e.g., 'A').

methods.name: setColumnIndex
methods.description: Sets the column index, converting input to uppercase and validating within the table range if applicable.

methods.name: getShowFilterButton
methods.description: Returns whether the filter button is shown for this column.

methods.name: setShowFilterButton
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the filter button for this column.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the parent table of this column.

methods.name: setTable
methods.description: Associates this column with a specific table.

methods.name: updateStructuredReferences
methods.description: Static method to update structured references in formulas and named formulas across worksheets when the table header title changes.

methods.name: updateStructuredReferencesInCells
methods.description: Private static method to update structured references within cell formulas in a worksheet.

methods.name: updateStructuredReferencesInNamedFormulae
methods.description: Private static method to update structured references within named formulas in the spreadsheet.
